preview.videoModeDesc: The entire capture stays visible at its original content ratio

audioSource.label: Audio Source
audioSource.needOneSource: Keep at least one audio source

audioLab.title: Audio Lab
audioLab.description: Settings are persisted and apply from the next native recording.

outputChannels.title: Output channels
outputChannels.description: Mono suits speech and long recordings; stereo preserves media imaging.

echoCancellation.title: Echo cancellation
echoCancellation.description: Auto uses WebRTC AEC3 when microphone and system audio are both present.

meetingDetection.title: Automatic meeting detection
meetingDetection.description: Show a recording prompt when a meeting app uses audio input and output.

delayMode.title: Delay mode
delayMode.description: Controls how AEC3 receives the speaker-to-microphone delay hint.

fixedDelay.title: Fixed delay
fixedDelay.description: Used directly in fixed mode and as the initial value in hybrid mode (0–500 ms).

noiseSuppression.title: Noise suppression
noiseSuppression.description: Applied to near-end microphone speech; high levels may change timbre.

gainControl.title: Gain control
gainControl.description: Adjusts microphone loudness; monitor near-end timbre and breathing artifacts.

highPass.title: High-pass filter
highPass.description: Reduces low-frequency rumble and desk vibration.

messages.disabledWhileRecording: Settings are locked while recording or finalizing so the UI matches the active helper.
